name: James Oakley
biography: came to computer programming by way of microcontroller programming. He enjoys hands-on work with low level systems. His interests include computer graphics, digital electronics, security, and operating systems. In his unprofessional time he enjoys backpacking, science fiction, and designing games. He graduated from the Computer Science program at Dartmouth College.
